name: justbuildapps
description: Find a ready-made app before you build one, and post what you ship. Searches the JustBuildApps catalog of AI-built apps, and adds /justbuildapps:post to publish an update about your app from your latest commits.

jba_token.title: JustBuildApps token
jba_token.description: Only needed to post updates. Create one at justbuildapps.com/settings/tokens. Leave empty to search without an account.
